name: RFC2136 Dynamic DNS Plugin
description: DNS-01 challenge validation provider using RFC 2136 Dynamic DNS Updates. Compatible with any DNS server that supports RFC 2136 (BIND, Microsoft DNS, PowerDNS, Knot DNS, etc.). Authenticates DNS updates via TSIG (RFC 2845) shared keys.

dns_provider_config.Name: Rfc2136_Server
dns_provider_config.Description: DNS server hostname or IP address that accepts RFC 2136 dynamic updates.

dns_provider_config.Name: Rfc2136_Zone
dns_provider_config.Description: DNS zone (origin) into which TXT records will be written.

dns_provider_config.Name: Rfc2136_TsigKeyName
dns_provider_config.Description: Name of the TSIG key configured on the DNS server (as it appears in named.conf or equivalent).

dns_provider_config.Name: Rfc2136_TsigKey
dns_provider_config.Description: Base64-encoded TSIG key value. Pair with the key name configured on the DNS server.

dns_provider_config.Name: Rfc2136_TsigAlgorithm
dns_provider_config.Description: TSIG algorithm. Common values: hmac-sha256 (default), hmac-sha512, hmac-sha1, hmac-md5.
